entities.summary: Tamara Ganiyeva (b. 1951-01-25, Kinzyabayevo) was a journalist or media commentator of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Kinzyabayevo. Known in the fields of poets & playwrights.
